rows.grounds: first member of compound qualifying mantras
second member of compound indicating others
third member of compound describing discharged mantras
fourth member of compound specifying the object cut
feminine agent noun, epithet completing the compound
indeclinable marking sequential continuation in the nyāsa
locative indicating placement on the weapon limb

items.question: What epithet is assigned to the weapon limb in the sequential limb-nyāsa?
premises: The preceding verses enumerate names for limbs in order.
The term atha signals the next item in the sequence.
The locative astrake specifies the weapon limb as the locus.
items.inference: The epithet Sarva-para-unmukta-mantra-chedini is designated for placement on the weapon limb.
uncertainties: Whether astrake refers to a distinct limb or the astranyāsa gesture is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Then, on the weapon, [place the name] Sarva-para-unmukta-mantra-chedini, the cutter of all other released mantras.
